title: Thera eruption
summary: A massive eruption on Thera devastates the Aegean and disrupts Minoan networks.
body: Ash, tsunami, and the destruction of Akrotiri are archaeologically clear; the exact calendar year and the link to Egyptian chronology remain debated. Editorial draft for this timeline, not a substitute for specialist literature.

sources.name: Friedrich, The Minoan Eruption of Santorini
